rows.grounds: optative verb expressing injunction to perform worship
qualifies the devotion as highest or supreme
instrument expressing the manner of worship
compound indicating the fruit corresponding to each pīṭha
optative verb expressing the result attained

items.question: What result is attained by worship performed with supreme devotion at each sacred seat?
premises: Worship should be performed with supreme devotion.
The worship pertains to each sacred seat (pīṭha).
Each sacred seat has an associated fruit or reward.
items.inference: Therefore, worship with supreme devotion yields the fruit of each sacred seat.
items.plain_english: One should worship with supreme devotion and thereby obtain the fruit of each sacred seat.
